text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 17px; font-family: 'Noto Sans TC', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start

g.text: 一個問題，一條線

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'Noto Sans TC', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #5f5e5a

g.text: 預測的價值＝完美預測比最好的不預測做法好多少；每一章回答上一章留下的問題

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 11.5px; font-family: 'Noto Sans TC', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: middle; fill: #ffffff
font-weight: 700; font-size: 12px; font-family: 'Noto Sans TC', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #111111

g.text: 問題與賭注

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 9.5px; font-family: 'Noto Sans TC', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #6a6a66

g.text: 問

text.style: font-size: 10.5px; font-family: 'Noto Sans TC', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #111111

g.text: 預測能讓使用者回來時更快嗎？

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 9.5px; font-family: 'Noto Sans TC', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #6a6a66

g.text: 答

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 10.2px; font-family: 'Noto Sans TC', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #111111

g.text: 近年一批研究押注預測；我們一開始也這樣想

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 10.2px; font-family: 'Noto Sans TC', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: middle; fill: #111111

g.text: ▼ 預測的好處，最多有多大？

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 11.5px; font-family: 'Noto Sans TC', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: middle; fill: #ffffff
font-weight: 700; font-size: 12px; font-family: 'Noto Sans TC', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #111111

g.text: 最直接的版本：寫入時預知

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 9.5px; font-family: 'Noto Sans TC', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #c8472f

g.text: 問

text.style: font-size: 10.5px; font-family: 'Noto Sans TC', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #111111

g.text: 寫入時就依位置放好，有用嗎？

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 9.5px; font-family: 'Noto Sans TC', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #c8472f

g.text: 答

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 10.2px; font-family: 'Noto Sans TC', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #111111

g.text: 沒用：16 組比較 0 組贏（TTFT 差 −0.37～+1.16%）

text.style: font-size: 8.6px; font-family: 'Noto Sans TC', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #5f5e5a

g.text: 位置回來時一樣看得到；最前面的塊回來時多半靠重算，不從儲存讀

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 10.2px; font-family: 'Noto Sans TC', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: middle; fill: #111111

g.text: ▼ 預測只剩「回來時」。怎麼公平地量它？

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 11.5px; font-family: 'Noto Sans TC', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: middle; fill: #ffffff
font-weight: 700; font-size: 12px; font-family: 'Noto Sans TC', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #111111

g.text: 比較對象決定答案

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 9.5px; font-family: 'Noto Sans TC', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #d49a1c

g.text: 問

text.style: font-size: 10.5px; font-family: 'Noto Sans TC', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #111111

g.text: 預測值多少，取決於跟誰比？

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 9.5px; font-family: 'Noto Sans TC', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #d49a1c

g.text: 答

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 10.2px; font-family: 'Noto Sans TC', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #111111

g.text: 是。同一個完美預知：只能重算 15.9% → 有慢層 3.4% → 再加 Cake 2.6%

text.style: font-size: 8.6px; font-family: 'Noto Sans TC', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #5f5e5a

g.text: FreeInference 前 6 週、CPU 32 GiB、慢層 6.98 GiB/s、GPU 閒、對 LRU（模擬；另掃容量與頻寬）

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 10.2px; font-family: 'Noto Sans TC', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: middle; fill: #111111

g.text: ▼ 所以先把「不預測」做到最強

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 11.5px; font-family: 'Noto Sans TC', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: middle; fill: #ffffff
font-weight: 700; font-size: 12px; font-family: 'Noto Sans TC', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #111111

g.text: 把「不預測」的做法做到最強

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 9.5px; font-family: 'Noto Sans TC', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #2f6db5

g.text: 問

text.style: font-size: 10.5px; font-family: 'Noto Sans TC', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #111111

g.text: 最好的不預測做法是什麼？

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 9.5px; font-family: 'Noto Sans TC', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #2f6db5

g.text: 答

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 10.2px; font-family: 'Noto Sans TC', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #111111

g.text: 在 Cake 上加 INT4：最慢那層 12.1 秒 → 1.24 秒；CPU 層看解壓寫法（差 6.8 倍）

text.style: font-size: 8.6px; font-family: 'Noto Sans TC', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #5f5e5a

g.text: Cake 是別人已發表的方法，不是我們的；為了公平，不是主角

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 10.2px; font-family: 'Noto Sans TC', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: middle; fill: #111111

g.text: ▼ 不預測的做法做好了，預測還剩多少？

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 11.5px; font-family: 'Noto Sans TC', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: middle; fill: #ffffff
font-weight: 700; font-size: 12px; font-family: 'Noto Sans TC', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #111111

g.text: 在最強的不預測做法之上量上限

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 9.5px; font-family: 'Noto Sans TC', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #a8741a

g.text: 問

text.style: font-size: 10.5px; font-family: 'Noto Sans TC', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #111111

g.text: 完美預測最多再省多少？

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 9.5px; font-family: 'Noto Sans TC', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #a8741a

g.text: 答

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 10.2px; font-family: 'Noto Sans TC', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #111111

g.text: FreeInference ≤0.30%；Mooncake 預取 50.5% → 14.6%（128→1,024 GiB）

text.style: font-size: 8.6px; font-family: 'Noto Sans TC', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #5f5e5a

g.text: 取決於固定規則已命中多少（FreeInference 99.29%；Mooncake 沒算）

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 10.2px; font-family: 'Noto Sans TC', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: middle; fill: #111111

g.text: ▼ Mooncake 的大上限是真的嗎？

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 11.5px; font-family: 'Noto Sans TC', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: middle; fill: #ffffff
font-weight: 700; font-size: 12px; font-family: 'Noto Sans TC', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #111111

g.text: 大的上限還剩多少

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 9.5px; font-family: 'Noto Sans TC', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #2a8a5a

g.text: 問

text.style: font-size: 10.5px; font-family: 'Noto Sans TC', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #111111

g.text: 簡單的打字線索能拿到多少？

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 9.5px; font-family: 'Noto Sans TC', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #2a8a5a

g.text: 答

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 10.2px; font-family: 'Noto Sans TC', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #111111

g.text: 打字提示拿到完美預取改善的 0.81；完美預取只比它快 4.0%

text.style: font-size: 8.6px; font-family: 'Noto Sans TC', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #5f5e5a

g.text: 不是主流做法，是「不用預測」的參考點；含排隊上限再掉一半以上

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 10.2px; font-family: 'Noto Sans TC', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: middle; fill: #111111

g.text: ▼ 沒有這種簡單線索的部分呢？

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 11.5px; font-family: 'Noto Sans TC', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: middle; fill: #ffffff
font-weight: 700; font-size: 12px; font-family: 'Noto Sans TC', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #111111

g.text: 結論

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 9.5px; font-family: 'Noto Sans TC', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #1f6f48

g.text: 問

text.style: font-size: 10.5px; font-family: 'Noto Sans TC', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #111111

g.text: 預測值不值得？

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 9.5px; font-family: 'Noto Sans TC', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #1f6f48

g.text: 答

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 10.2px; font-family: 'Noto Sans TC', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #111111

g.text: 兩份紀錄上有限：FreeInference 幾乎沒有；對話上打字線索拿到大部分

text.style: font-size: 8.6px; font-family: 'Noto Sans TC', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #5f5e5a

g.text: 待解：淘汰順序、Mooncake toolagent、Mooncake 命中率、真的預測器

text.style: font-size: 8.4px; font-family: 'Noto Sans TC', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #5f5e5a

g.text: 實測：寫入時放置、INT4（在 Cake 上）、解壓、打字提示（GPU 縮小重播）。模擬：15.9%→2.6%、完美預測上限、含排隊。
